300.title: Poland Producer Inflation Tops Forecasts
300.summary: News / Trading Economics / Poland Producer Inflation Tops Forecasts Poland Producer Inflation Tops Forecasts Less than 1 min read PLPPIYY Producer prices in Poland rose by 6.1% year-on-year in September 2026, exceeding market expectations for a 5.8% gain and accelerating from an upwardly revised 4.8% increase in the previous month.
300.body: News / Trading Economics / Poland Producer Inflation Tops Forecasts Poland Producer Inflation Tops Forecasts Less than 1 min read PLPPIYY Producer prices in Poland rose by 6.1% year-on-year in September 2026, exceeding market expectations for a 5.8% gain and accelerating from an upwardly revised 4.8% increase in the previous month. This marked the seventh consecutive month of producer price growth and the highest reading since April 2023, driven by higher prices in all the major sectors, such as mining and quarrying (7.8% vs 6.8% in August), manufacturing (6.4% vs 5.1%), and electricity, gas steam and air conditioning (4.2% vs 2.7%). Meanwhile, producer inflation remained steady at 2.1% for water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities. For the January to September period, producer prices were 1.9% higher compared to a year ago.
